final: WITH per_tx AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS o FROM per_tx WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt FROM per_tx p, overall WHERE p.avg_cnt > overall.o), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.transref, kept.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, kept.avg_cnt - overall.o AS diff_overall, kept.avg_cnt - kept_avg.k AS diff_kept FROM kept, overall, kept_avg ORDER BY diff_kept DESC LIMIT 10
